item.title: Inside the V2 rocket, Nazi Wonder Weapon
item.description: Few weapons have changed warfare as much as the V2 rocket. Built during World War II, it was the first long-range, mass-produced ballistic missile and the first human-made object to reach beyond Earth’s atmosphere.
